blank_inputs.description: Generate this number of blank input lines; useful for generating numbered lists with variable 'n'.

keep_false.description: Print blank lines for lines that test as False. Default is to filter out False lines from the output.

macro_group.description: Specify group macros for save and delete; default is user.

text_file.description: Specify text file to load. For advanced users, you should typically cat a file into pyp.
